notes.title: Exotica:Petshop Simulator v1.0 Update is Live!
notes.content:
We are happiness to announce the v1.0 update for Exotica:Petshop Simulator. Thank you for all your support and feedback.

[h3][b]Added[/b][/h3]

-3440x1440 resolution has been added.

[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]

-Translations of existing languages have been completed.
- When the cashier went home, the customer notification was not working. Fixed.
-Capacities of large selling and breeding terrariums have been doubled.
-43x38x25 and 58x40x40 bird cages were not requested by the customer. Fixed.

notes.title: CASHER AND FIXES
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello animal lovers![/b][/h2]

We've released an update to fix some community-reported issues, including improvements, and make new additions. Make sure to update your game to the latest version to apply the latest update. Thank you for helping us improve the game.


[h2][b][Added][/b][/h2]
-Steam Cloud feature has been activated.
-Fast selling and carry button has been added as a column to living spaces.
-Multiple selling feature has been added for all items in the depot.
-Mouse sensitivity setting has been added.
-2K Resolution added.
-New animals have been added.
-The Cashier feature has been added to the employees.(Important Note: The employee agency list is renewed on the 7th-14th-21st-28th days of each month. You have to wait for one of these days to get an employee with the cashier feature. Because the cashier feature will be disabled for the employees you currently have.)
-A chart has been added where our daily sales logs are kept. Here you will be able to see the items you sell or cannot sell. (The items that are out of stock and unsold are indicated in red in the list.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42914503/95a7b9a7faa49442d2c70c78afa5e0dec8e5166e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42914503/e9f572933aa35bb5fb42c93cb2cc088206964605.png[/img]

[h2][b][Improvements][/b][/h2]
-Customers will ask for animals in order (They will ask for Fish-Bird-Rodent-Terrarium animal in order.) Important Note: Customers will randomly inquire which animals you have.
-The quick add button (+) of the stands has been moved to the top of the list.
-Shift+LMB (+)(-)5 function has been added in the accessory stand for faster addition and removal.
-Purchase limit increased to 100.
- "E" interaction key has been stabilized.

[h2][b][Balance][/b][/h2]
-Bank loan maximum limit has been reduced to $15,000.
-Maximum shop reputation has been increased to 50,000.
-The amount of EXP requested per level has been increased.
-Barbooth maximum bid reduced to $1,000.

[h2][b][Bug fixes][/b][/h2]
[h3][b]1) Living spaces and Stands[/b][/h3]
-Fixed the issue where stands and living spaces were saved inside each other.
-The bug of living spaces hanging in the air has been fixed.
-Fixed the problem of relocating and selling quickly even though the furniture is full.
-Fixed the bug of % when cleaning the living area when cleaning is 0%.
[h2]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/h2] When you enter the game, you have to save the game for once, exit the game and enter it again. After doing this, the faulty stand, aquarium, animals and accessories will be deleted from the world.

[h3][b]2) Employees and Customers[/b][/h3]
-Employees stopped going to another job after finishing one job. Fixed.
-Employees were getting into bugs while cleaning the floors, this problem has been fixed.
-Fixed the bug where the customer list stays white when we go home and save the game in bed when the customer comes to the shop.
-Fixed a bug where customers were stuck and not coming to the shop.
-Fixed the bug of customers constantly requesting terrariums.

[h3][b]3)Bank Loan[/b][/h3]
-Fixed the error of withdrawing $0 credit from the bank and not being able to use credit for 1 month due to this error.

[h2][b]◈ Notes[/b][/h2]
In case of fatal error, it is recommended to restart the game with a new save file.
Your reports are very important to improving the game and we are happy to have you with us along the way. Please feel free to let us know if you have anything to share.

notes.title: HOSE ADDED and BUGS FIXED
notes.content:
[b]ADDED[/b]
-Aquarium filling-draining system with a hose has been added.

[b]Usage Description[/b]

There are 2 types of hoses. Water filling hose [b](Blue colour)[/b], Water drain hose [b](Red colour)[/b].
--To fill the aquarium, simply take the filling hose, go to the aquarium and press the[b] LMB[/b]. After the aquarium is filled, the hose will come to your hand again and you will be able to continue the filling process. With [b]RMB[/b], it drop the hose out of your hand from wherever you are.
--To drain the aquarium, simply take the drain hose, go to the aquarium and press the [b]LMB[/b]. After the aquarium is drain, the hose will come to your hand again and you will be able to continue the draining process. With [b]RMB[/b], it drop the hose out of your hand from wherever you are.
